about_the_game:
King Parrot is a realistic first-person pirate action RPG that fuses the visceral melee combat of Vermintide with realistic graphics and naval combat mechanics

Sail into chaos as you and your crew fight through hordes of enemies in brutal, physics-based battles. Every swing, block, and parry is grounded in weight and impact. No button-mashing, just raw skill and timing.

⚓ FEATURES

  • Co-op Adventure – Join friends online to take on dynamic combat missions, defend ships, or raid enemy strongholds together.

  • Realistic Physics Combat – Every strike feels authentic thanks to advanced motion and collision systems.

  • Gritty Pirate World – Explore coastal towns, cursed islands, and massive naval battlefields shaped by wind, tide, and steel.

  • Progression & Customization – Upgrade weapons, forge gear, and build your legend as the most feared parrot-crested captain on the seas.

  • Inspired by Classics – Combines the exploration and freedom of Skyrim with the intense cooperative melee of Vermintide.

Gather your crew, grab your cutlass, and carve your name into pirate legend.
The sea is calling, will you answer?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: intel core i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: Fight, plunder, and survive in a gritty, physics-based co-op pirate action RPG inspired by Skyrim and Vermintide. Team up, wield steel, and battle relentless foes on the high seas.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian*, German, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Russian
*languages with full audio support
